captions.detailed: A 3D-printable model of a golf tee or support peg. It consists of a long, thin cylindrical shaft transitioning into a wider, conical cup-like head at the top. The top surface of the cone is flat, creating a solid platform for supporting other items.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric golf tee or support peg in OpenSCAD. The model should feature a cylindrical post of adjustable height and diameter, topped with a flared conical head whose base and top diameters can be customized.
captions.factory: The model is built using a union of three parts. First, a central cylinder forms the main vertical post. Second, a spiral module is defined using a mathematical loop that places small linear_extrude polygon segments to form a spiral pattern, although it is visually hidden or minimized in this configuration. Third, a flared cone at the top of the post is generated using the hull module to bridge a smaller cylinder at the post transition with a larger cylinder at the top.
